gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.663831 44.964816)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.663831 44.964816)',4326)::geography,
        2000
      )
  AND tourism = 'hotel';

WITH target_poi AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.663831 44.964816)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
hotel_poi AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.727069 43.551072)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(target_poi.geom, 2000) AS geom
  FROM 
    target_poi
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, 1, buffered_area.geom, true) AS rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, buffered_area
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, buffered_area.geom)
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_ValueCount(rast, true) AS stats
  FROM 
    clipped_dem
),
elevation_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    (stats).sum / (stats).count AS avg_elevation
  FROM 
    elevation_stats
)
SELECT 
  ST_Distance(target_poi.geom, hotel_poi.geom) AS distance_meters,
  avg_elevation
FROM 
  target_poi, hotel_poi, elevation_summary;
